desc: Inspired by the Professional 1911, employed by the FBI’s Hostage Rescue Team, TRP pistols are hand fit for function and beauty. The TRP Classic has a combat-driven feature set and the clean lines of the original. Typically reserved for custom firearms, the TRP Classic features 20 line-per-inch (LPI) checkering for a firm grip as well as top slide serrations for reduce glare and faster sight alignment.
